acceptance_rule: A candidate is source-resolved automatically only when a Tier-A or Tier-B hash identifies exactly one external function source.

hash_evidence_tiers.TIER_A: 64-hex token already present in the candidate-specific B2 function hints
hash_evidence_tiers.TIER_B: 64-hex token occurring within four lines of the candidate id in a historical file
hash_evidence_tiers.TIER_C: hash occurring only in broad historical context; diagnostic only

resolution_strategy: candidate-linked SHA-256 reverse lookup before function-name matching
